Kim / team — technical proposal notes below (short). I’ll put a formal doc together after we sync with Alex.

Proposed isolation pattern for sequestered analytics enclave:
- Dedicated VPC + dedicated cluster (no shared control plane instances).
- Cross-cluster replication via read-only snapshotting (replicator service) to avoid KV cache leakage.
- Separate KMS key per environment; customers can bring their own (BYOK) or we can provision a customer-dedicated key in the customer-managed KMS.
- Net policy: deny egress from enclave to external apps except approved analytics endpoints.
- Audit-forwarding: stream request logs to a separate storage bucket with immutability and to your SIEM for real-time alerting.

Risks / notes:
- Replication lag depends on snapshot cadence (we should agree on RPO). Near-real-time streams increase complexity and cost.
- Some model-serving features (shared prefix caches) will not be usable across the isolation boundary.

Attaching a basic architecture diagram to visualize the VPC separation.

— Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: isolation-arch-diagram.png
